title: Two-qubit teleportation through a noisy channel, corrected from measurement counts: code and data

creators.name: Abdolhosseini, Amir H.
creators.affiliation: University of Tehran, Faculty of Electrical and Computer Engineering

description: Code, data and notebooks of a study of two-qubit quantum teleportation through a noisy channel whose correction (one parametric gate per channel qubit) is learned from measurement counts only. The package simulates the six-qubit protocol exactly, implements the counts-only calibrators, the ceiling of any correction, process tomography (TOMO-9, TOMO-75) and drift tracking, and rebuilds every result of the experiments on the IBM devices from their raw counts, which are included: ibm_kingston on 4 October 2026, and a replication on ibm_kingston and a second device, ibm_fez, on 25 October 2026.
